hypothesis: One substrate-independent dynamical structure compiles into multiple media whose readbacks recover the identical abstract trajectory (verified structural identity).

controls.description: Each medium's readback composed with its compiler must be the identity on the trajectory.
All media must read back to the same abstract trajectory.
The structure must visit both regimes and show a mid-level in both regimes.

gates.criterion: Every medium's readback-of-compile equals the identity on the trajectory.
All media read back to the same abstract trajectory.
The abstract structure visits both regimes.
A level between the thresholds occurs in both regimes.
